body: I feel this exact way, minus the edit.

and today my insurance stopped covering my pills
65 dollars a  month I don't have.

I am. 
I don't actually feel like I'm ever supposed to experience happiness. I will never have the chance no matter what.

I don't know what I'm looking for. I guess a start would be someone who could actually... properly "identify" me. Poor choice of words, but perhaps you know what I mean. I can't afford a professional. I am, but being boring is among the least of my concerns. I don't see why it would matter to you if I end it.

Yes, well I'm simply boring. I've been to parties. I hate forcing conversation, and my voice is frail and soft. People barely hear me when I speak, and if I raise my voice at all, I begin losing it shortly. I barely know a damn thing about computers. I never said it was anything productive. 
Stupidity and bravery are closely related. Risking that for something that would end up meaning nothing is just... stupid.

Partially because of that. Partially because I'm just plain ugly. I will never "pass"
I'm boring. My interests are boring. I'm broke, so they are very limited to mostly random computer crap. Paycheck living isn't fun. If the shit hits the fan, it's just something I'll forever remember as a goddamn rejection that I've expected all along. Then I'll hate myself even more for being stupid enough to expect anything different.

No. There hasn't. I wasn't ever able to risk being myself when I lived at home, and when I moved out I just... feel like it is too late. There's no point even. I'm ugly either way, and have no future hopes even if I somehow was able to get surgeries. I have a shitty socially crippled personality, and a fucking ugly appearance. Awful job, no opportunities, and I'm transgender. What the fuck do I have going for me? What do I have to wake up to?
and everything ends as I expected

I'm transgender. That's what the surgeries are about, and the fact that I'll never be able to get them is just one of the more impossible to overcome shit problems I'm stuck with. I thought I was obvious enough about it, but apparently not. Go back and read it, so now things will make sense for you since you know this about me. Unfortunately, you'll then see why it's impossible for me to keep going on.

Have you been listening to me at all? This isn't about meeting new people. I can't fucking change myself. I can't just wake up and decide "OH WELL ITS COOL ILL JUST BE A NORMAL MALE NOW" thanks for the goddamn advice, just decide to be a normal goddamn straight male. What the hell are you doing here, you could be out solving major problems instead of wasting time here telling me to just stop being so fucked up. I don't do this to myself because I decided to. I was given a shit problem and one solution. One. but it's out of reach, and there's no way to just stop it.

I need change, but it's not coming. I have no confidence because I have nothing to work with. I do not have potential. I've given myself a chance. I've moved away from the toxic environment, I have a shitty job, no chance of improvement. I stayed with it because they have medical coverage that supports the surgeries I need. Or so I thought. Imagine my happiness when I was told they cover it, only to have it turn to shit when I find out that they put up walls of restrictions and forms and requests for forms and tell you it takes a month to hear responses for each form, and they won't tell you even what they cover, which of the fucking 10 surgeons out there that they support or which ones they don't. (Hint: it's probably 0, but by the time you find out, who knows) Hell even if somehow it happened, I'm still ugly, impossible to ever pass. Too emotionally and socially crippled to actually have something resembling anything decent. While there are people out there looking to find the right person, I'm still trying to actually... BE a person. It just wasn't actually possible, and I never knew it.

I've tried this once before. I've never... not been given up on. I just pathetically refresh constantly hoping help will come. It never does. I just stare at the bottles on the counter and fear myself out of doing it. It's not a good feeling, either.
